# Bid the liner, the hearth, and the stack.

> Price a fireplace-insert install from fuel, liner footage, hearth, gas run, dedicated circuit, surround, and stack height — not a published $2,499-installed gas special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
